title: Pacific Nation Nauru Officially Changes Name to Republic of Naoero
summary: Pacific Nation Nauru Officially Changes Name to Republic of Naoero

items: Nauru officially changed its name to **Republic of Naoero** (3rd-smallest country by population after Vatican City & Tuvalu; Currency: Australian Dollar).
